verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs describe Actions, its automation and extensibility mechanism, as versioned functions, so the versioning part of the story is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence documents reviewing changes or rolling back to an earlier version. Tenant-config tooling such as the CLI and the Terraform module could only serve as an external workaround, not native review or rollback. missing for 10: documented version history and diff/review workflow for Actions, documented rollback to a prior Action version, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Actions are a more secure, tenant-specific, versioned Node.js functions that let you customize your login and identity flows.
